tom-contractor: Hi @celine-peopleops / quick Q: my SOW lists 3 PTO days but the company shutdown (Dec 24-26) overlaps two local bank holidays. Can those days be marked as company-covered so I don't lose PTO?

celine-peopleops: Short answer: we can often mark statutory overlap days as "shutdown credit" for contractors, but it depends on vendor terms and payroll cutoffs. Please submit a Leave Exception with SOW attached.

ira-mgr: I support this for Tom. I'll approve in portal once submitted.

payroll-bot: Note: Year-end payroll cutoff for contractor adjustments is Dec 10. Requests after that will default to non-cash shutdown credit.

tom-contractor: Submitted EX-2026-7777 with SOW attached. Thanks!

celine-peopleops: Got it / EX-2026-7777 received. Ira approved. We'll confirm with vendor payroll and update status here by EOD Dec 8. If payroll can process, we'll convert to paid days; otherwise you'll get shutdown credit separate from your 3 PTO days.
